subject: Last-mile numbers lock + Friday rundown
body:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, Chris Taylor <chris.t@acmeanalytics.com>, Acme Analytics Finance <finance@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Jul 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Last-mile numbers lock + Friday rundown

Team / Chris —

We have one business day left before Friday's roster submission closes. Quick, focused ask: can everyone confirm the commit line they want included in the Q3 submission by EOD today? We need the following for each active opportunity:

- Final committed $
- Target close date (month)
- Stage tag to lock (e.g., Commit / Commit at Risk / Commit - Needs Approvals)
- Any blockers or PO / procurement timing notes

Attached: Q3_commit_rollup.xlsx (sheet: "final_lock") — please update only your rows.

Chris / Acme team: if your procurement team is issuing a PO this week, please send a scanned copy to finance@redwood.com and drop the PO number here; we will mark your line as "Funded" for the submission.

Plan for Friday sync (10:00 PT):
- 10:00 — Quick numbers readout (me)
- 10:10 — Top 5 deals: owners call out last-mile blockers (30s each)
- 10:25 — Billing / procurement confirmations (Ben + Acme)
- 10:35 — Risk tags & fallback plan (Vivek)
- 10:40 — Final Q&A and lock decision

If numbers are not updated by EOD, we'll assume the latest pipeline values and may escalate to RevOps for follow up.

Thanks — short and decisive today.

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Chris Taylor <chris.t@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Jul 2028 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Last-mile numbers lock + Friday rundown

Thanks Steph — pulling in quick numbers below for the rows I manage. I updated the sheet and flagged one account as "Commit - Needs Approvals."

- Acme Analytics: $325,000 — Target close Aug 2028 — Stage: Commit (PO pending) — note: procurement expects signed SOW + PO within 3 business days once legal clears redlines.
- Bluewave Media: $120,000 — Target close Jul 2028 — Stage: Commit at Risk — awaiting senior budget signoff.
- Ceta Labs: $60,000 — Target close Jul 2028 — Stage: Commit — fully approved, billing ready.

Blockers: Acme's legal requested a one-line change to the data retention clause; legal queue is 24–48 hrs. If redline holds, finance will not issue PO until signed SOW is final.

I will present the Acme blocker at the call and propose a timeboxed escalation with Legal.

— Vivek

On Sat, 22 Jul 2028 at 12:04:23 -0700, Chris Taylor <chris.t@acmeanalytics.com> wrote:
> Hi Stephanie / Vivek —
>
> Thanks for the heads up. Procurement has approved the order in principle and I attached the PO stub (ACME_PO_78921.pdf). Legal is still reviewing the single SOW redline (data retention sentence).
>
> Our finance lead is copied here: finance@acmeanalytics.com — they will confirm the final PO number once legal signs. If legal delays past Thursday EOD, can Redwood provision an interim invoice to avoid gating our implementation start?
>
> Chris
>Chris Taylor
>Head of Business Ops, Acme Analytics
>
>Attachment: ACME_PO_78921.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

On Sat, 22 Jul 2028 at 16:45:00 -0700, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com> wrote:
> Received and thanks Chris — I pulled your PO into the rollup and set Acme's status to "Commit (funding pending)".
>
> Responses / next steps:
> - Ben will follow up with Acme finance on invoicing options and confirm whether interim invoicing is available. (Ben)
> - Vivek will own the legal escalation if redline is not cleared before Thursday; recommend a 24-hour SLA for legal once we flag it as a revenue blocker. (Vivek)
> - Marissa will produce the final submission sheet and run the submission through RevOps at 9:00 PT on Friday. If you need a pre-lock sanity check, ping Marissa by 17:00 PT. (Marissa)
>
> Friday call details: 10:00 PT / 17:00 UTC — Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/987654321?pwd=forecast
> Agenda: quick readout, top blockers, billing confirmations, lock decision.
>
> If anyone needs to escalate or swap time, DM me. Otherwise I'll lock numbers on Friday after the call and publish the final file to the forecast folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-Q3-forecast
>
> Thanks team — last mile focus.
>
> — Stephanie
>
>Signature: Stephanie Nguyen | Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
